Correction to v0.1.75, from the first two joins on it.

## Server

### Fixed
- The record swap is undone before the re-issued corrected load, not only in the post-hook and the guard. On a live host the post-hook did not run, the guard was still most of a second away, and the corrected load ran 128 ms after the swap: its lookup by synthetic id found nothing, the game made a NEW record under that id, and the client got a new-character answer after all. The guard now runs every scheduler tick as well.
- A second record under the same synthetic id, which only that sequence could have produced, is retired at the next join (its id gets a `#dup` suffix) so neither loads nor saves can match it again. The first record is the player's.
